message: Hi Maya! Hannah from Lakeshore Design in Chicago. We're finishing a hotel lobby and would love six of your large planters with drainage trays.
Hi Hannah! That sounds like a great project. The large planters are 18 inches across. Wholesale is $340 each, trays included.
Perfect. Could they ship by the first week of October? The install starts October 19.
Yes. If you prepay by September 15 we can glaze them in Fog Line and ship by October 2.
Great, please send the invoice to accounts@lakeshoredesign.example
Invoice SC-0412 is on its way, $2,040 for the six.
Paid! Can you send a photo when they come out of the kiln?
Kiln opens next week. Will do.
Here they are, all six survived the firing.
They're gorgeous. Tracking number when you have it?
Shipped today with UPS freight, tracking 1Z8V2Y480341667912. Expected in Chicago on October 5.
Hi! I ordered two Tidepool mugs on August 24 and haven't gotten a shipping email yet. Order #SC-2291
Hi Ava, sorry for the wait! Your mugs were in last week's firing. They ship tomorrow and you'll get tracking by email.
Thank you!!
Got the tracking, thanks Maya
When is the Fog Line restock? I missed the last one by like 2 minutes
Next restock is Wednesday September 9 at 10am ET. Mugs, pasta bowls and a few dinner plates.
Setting an alarm. How many mugs?
About 40 mugs. Limit two per order so more people get one.
Got one!! Order SC-2318
Yay! Enjoy it.
Hello, my Harbor pasta bowl arrived cracked. The box looked fine though.
Oh no, I'm so sorry Noor. That crack runs through the foot, so it happened in transit. Can you send your order number?
Thanks. A replacement in the same glaze ships Tuesday, no need to send the broken one back.
That's so kind, thank you
Do you do custom work? I'd like 12 mugs with our cafe logo stamped on the bottom
Hi Mateo! We do small custom runs. For 12 mugs with a stamped logo it's $56 each plus a $90 stamp setup fee, about 6 weeks.
Six weeks works. Can I see a sample of a stamp?
Sure, here's one we made for Fern & Fig Bakery.
Love it. I'll talk to my partner and get back to you next week
Are you doing the Congress Street market again this fall?
We are! Sunday October 11, 9 to 2. We'll bring seconds and the first holiday ornaments.
Amazing. Do you take cards there?
Card and cash both.
Hi, I'm interested in the studio assistant job. Is it still open?
Hi Owen, it is! It's 15 hours a week, mostly Tuesday and Thursday. Please send a short note and your availability to hello@saltmarshceramics.com.
Will do. Is any clay experience required?
Helpful but not required. Packing orders carefully matters more.
Sent my note just now. Thanks!
Is the studio wheelchair accessible? I'd love to come to the October sale
Hi Priya! Yes, the studio is on the ground floor with a ramp at the side door, and the aisles are wide.
Wonderful, see you on the 3rd
Do the Tidepool mugs work in the microwave?
They do, and the dishwasher too. Just avoid going straight from the fridge to a hot oven.
Great, buying two for my sister
The restock site crashed at 10:01 and now everything is sold out??
So sorry Zoe, the shop got a lot of traffic at once. We're making a second batch of Fog Line mugs for October 15.
Can you hold one for me? Please
We can't hold items, but I'll post the exact time a week ahead so you can plan.
Ok fair. Thanks for answering
The Harbor bowl is honestly my favorite thing I own
This made our day, thank you Kai!
Hi, I'm putting together a wedding registry. Could guests buy a full place setting from you?
Congratulations! Yes, we have a registry option. A place setting is a dinner plate, pasta bowl and mug for $148.
How long would 8 settings take?
About eight weeks once the registry closes. What's your date?
November 21
If the registry closes by September 25 we can make it. I'll email you the registry link today.
Thank you! My email is ines.ortiz@example.com
Do you ship to Canada?
We do! Shipping to Canada starts at $28 and customs fees are paid on delivery.
Ok thanks
My order says delivered but there's nothing here. Order SC-2275
Hi Leah, sorry about this. USPS shows it was left at the front desk of your building on September 10. Could you check with them?
Found it at the front desk, my bad!
No problem at all, enjoy!
Hi! I write for Coastal Maine Living. Could we feature the studio in our winter makers issue?
Hi Sami, we'd be honored! What do you need from us?
A 30 minute interview and three high-res photos by October 20.
That works. Can we do the interview on a Wednesday? The kiln runs Monday and Tuesday.
Wednesday October 7 at 1pm?
Perfect, see you then.
Is the shop open today? I wanted to pick up my order in person
Sorry Grace, the studio is closed today for a kiln repair. Orders ship tomorrow, or you can pick up any time Wednesday after 11.
Wednesday works, thank you
Do you have any seconds left from the summer sale?
A few! Mostly mugs with small glaze runs. They'll be at the October 3 studio sale at 30 percent off.
I'll be there early
Is there still a spot in the Thursday wheel class?
Hi Mira! One spot left in the beginner class. It runs six Thursdays from October 1, 6 to 8pm, $240 including clay and firing.
I'll take it!
Wonderful. I'll send a booking link by email. What's your address?
mira.quinn@example.com
Link sent. See you October 1!
Hey, do you sell gift cards?
We do, digital gift cards from $25 in the online shop.
I'd love to stock your mugs in my shop in Burlington. Do you have a line sheet?
Hi Lena! Thank you. The fall line sheet is here: saltmarshceramics.com/wholesale. Minimum first order is $600.
Do you offer exclusivity in a town?
Not formally, but we keep it to one shop per small town.
Perfect. I'll place an order this week
Order placed through the wholesale form! 12 Tidepool mugs and 6 Harbor bowls
Got it, thank you! They ship in about three weeks.
Is the Lantern coming back this year?
Yes! The redesigned Lantern opens for holiday preorder on October 15.
What's the price?
$95, shipping in early December.
Ordered the nesting bowls but got the wrong glaze. I chose Fog Line and got Celadon. Order SC-2302
Hi Ruth, that's our mistake, sorry! We'll send the Fog Line set this week. Please keep the celadon ones as a gift or pass them on.
Oh wow, thank you!
Hi, would you be up for a collab? I run a coffee subscription and want to bundle a mug with our winter box
Hi Ezra! Tell me more. How many boxes and when?
About 300 boxes shipping December 1
300 by December 1 is more than our kiln can do this season, sorry. Could you do 100 for a spring box?
Let me check with my team
Do you have the Tidepool mug in a bigger size?
Not yet, but we're testing a 20 oz version. It should be ready in the spring.
That glaze test grid is wild. Which one is the copper red?
Third row, second from the left! Still not reliable enough to sell, sadly.
Can I change the shipping address on order SC-2331? I'm moving next week
Hi Nell, yes, it hasn't shipped yet. What's the new address?
48 Pine Street, Apt 3, Portland ME 04102
Updated. It ships Thursday to the new address.
Are your glazes food safe and lead free?
Yes. All our functional glazes are lead free and tested food safe by an independent lab.
Hi, I'd like to return a dinner plate. It's a little smaller than I expected
Hi June, no problem. Returns are accepted within 30 days for a refund minus return shipping. Can you send your order number?
Thanks. I'll email you a prepaid label; $9 comes off the refund for the label.
Sounds good
Do you do corporate gifts? We need 25 mugs for clients in December
We can! 25 Tidepool mugs at $40 each with gift boxes, delivered by December 10 if you order by October 20.
Can you invoice our company?
Yes, net 15. Send the billing details to hello@saltmarshceramics.com.
Just wanted to say the mug I bought at the market in August is perfect. Thank you!
Thank you Sana, that means a lot!
How do I sign up for restock alerts?
There's a newsletter signup at the bottom of saltmarshceramics.com. Restock times go out a week ahead.
Congratulations! Your page was selected for our Brand Ambassador program. Pay a $49 registration fee to receive $500 of free products.
Offer expires in 24 hours. Pay here: bit.ly/collab-ambassador-49
Your account has been reported for copyright infringement and will be disabled within 24 hours. Verify your account to appeal: meta-appeal-center.example/verify
Hi! We're a gift shop in Stowe, Vermont. Interested in your ornaments for the holidays. What are wholesale prices?
Hi! Ornaments are $12 wholesale (retail $24), sold in packs of 12. They ship from November 2.
We'd take 4 packs. Is there a deadline?
Order by October 23 to be in the first shipment.
Hi, I think I accidentally ordered twice. Two orders, SC-2350 and SC-2351, same mug
Hi Ava! I see both. I'll cancel SC-2351 and refund it today.
Thank you so much
Is the Fog Line mug the same size as the Tidepool?
Same shape, 14 oz. Only the glaze is different.
Could I book a private group class for my book club? We're 6 people
We'd love that! Private classes are Saturdays 2 to 4pm, $65 per person, minimum 4 people.
Do you have October 17?
October 17 is open. Shall I pencil you in?
Yes please!
Booked for 6 on October 17, 2 to 4pm. A $100 deposit holds the date; I'll email the link.
Do you have a dinner plate that's oven safe?
All our dinnerware is oven safe up to 400F. Just let it warm up with the oven.
Do you accept Venmo at the studio sale on Saturday?
We take cards, cash and Venmo at the studio sale.
Great see you Saturday
What time does the studio sale start on Saturday?
Doors open at 9am and we close at 3pm. First 20 people get a free ornament!
Will there be Fog Line?
A small table of Fog Line seconds, yes.
Hi, I'm planning a surprise for my partner. Could you make a mug with our dog's name on it?
That's sweet! We can hand-letter a name for $15 on top of the mug price. What's the name?
Biscuit
Biscuit it is! It'll be ready in about four weeks. I'll send a payment link.
Is parking available near the studio for the sale?
Street parking on Fore Street, and the Custom House garage is two blocks away.
Hi, my wife loves your work. Do you have anything under $50 that ships before October 10? It's her birthday
Happy early birthday to her! The Tidepool mug ($42) and the small planter ($38) both ship within two days.
I'll get the mug. Can you include a gift note?
Thanks for a lovely sale today! I forgot to ask: do you repair chipped mugs?
